signals.evidence: Reauvén Barsheshet describes injury from service: 'The pain from the injury during service was also psychological.' He reports loss of sensation, inability to move his hand, and had to stop serving.
Two reserve soldiers' apartment in Netanya was burglarized while they were on duty; police closed the investigation without arrests. They reported theft of military equipment and 85,000 shekels.

Bank of Israel extended the enrollment window for war-affected households and businesses support framework by one additional month, allowing payment deferrals, mortgage extensions, and increased credit lines.

Rail service disrupted: frequency reduced on Modi'in-Jerusalem line to once per hour; Holon-Bat Yam stations reduced to once per hour; 6 of 67 stations still closed including Yiknaam-Kafr Yehoshua, Kiryat Haim, Hotzot HaMifraz, Raanana South, Tzome Holon, and Bat Yam-Komemiyut.
Approximately 15 toddlers up to age 3 arrived at Dana-Dwek Hospital in Ichilov with symptoms of vomiting and diarrhea from food poisoning; most in mild condition.

Ministry of Health and Environmental Protection announced that entry to Meshushim Pool in the Golan may be dangerous due to abnormal water contamination test results (400 fecal coliforms per 100ml, exceeding Health Ministry recommendations).

Yehali Ifirgan, 16-year-old student in Shlomi near Lebanon border: 'We're not prepared for the exam at all. If we were living in Ramat HaSharon or Tel Aviv and Hezbollah was shooting there, it would look completely different.'

Of 11,000 Kiryat Shmona residents who requested a four-night respite break from shelters, more than half were left behind due to budget shortage. Only 4,600 places allocated; 8,500 residents from border communities went in first rotation; over 6,000 requests from the city were rejected.

President Isaac Herzog at meeting with bereaved families: 'Each of the fallen is a world unto himself. As we approach Memorial Day, when so many families carry this pain, we cannot but agree that there are things greater and more important than any daily dispute—foremost among them our unity as a people.'
Organization of Widows and Orphans of IDF reports that since Iron Swords war began, approximately 356 new widows and widowers were added, including 46 pregnant widows, and 907 new orphans.

Independence Day central stages cancelled in most local authorities due to security situation and Home Front Command restrictions on mass gatherings, leaving thousands of artists, technicians, and production staff facing contract cancellations.

Local authorities agreed to book cancelled Independence Day artists for alternative events throughout the year (Jerusalem Day, summer events, holidays) to prevent economic harm to artists and production crews.

Business owner in Galilee: 'There's no work, no income, but expenses continue as usual. Rent, employees, suppliers. It's an impossible situation... Couriers don't enter the area. There are orders that haven't been collected in weeks. Drivers are in reserves, there's no continuity of work—everything is broken.'

Business owner describes shelter inadequacy: 'There's not enough protection. In one alert dozens of people are crammed into one shelter, and there's no room for everyone. People are afraid to come, and workers are afraid to work in such conditions.'

Parent of northern high school student: 'We haven't returned to studies. Learning is very fragmented on Zoom, one or two hours a day, barely. We also know what it means when teenagers have to get on Zoom—they don't sleep at night, they get on Zoom, they're not focused.'

Parent of northern student: 'They're demanding from children now under fire to come and study for matriculation exams in a focused way, one or two hours, in shelters, without conditions, without anything. And to take the exams themselves under fire. How is that possible?'

Initiative 'Victory in the Living Room' organized by bereaved families and soldiers will host hundreds of fighters and bereaved families in Israeli homes on Memorial Day eve for remembrance and valor meetings sharing stories of battles and Israeli spirit.
City of Eilat won Jerusalem Prize for Israeli Unity 2026 after hosting tens of thousands of evacuees and leading community initiatives to strengthen connection between different groups in society.

MamaMent launches 'MamaMent for Mothers in Northern Israel' project establishing permanent activity groups for mothers near their homes, combining physical activity, social meetings, and mutual support to strengthen personal and community resilience during uncertainty.

Research on Gaza envelope residents: 71% reported deterioration in general health; 40% taking or considering medication to cope; 58% showing hypervigilance; suffering from sleep disorders, chronic fatigue, and abdominal pain from chronic stress.

Six-year-old girl Shiba Badeer from Kafr Qasem died from brain hemorrhage; her family donated her organs, saving four children: 9-year-old girl received liver, 18-year-old girl received one kidney, 2.5-year-old boy received second kidney, 3.5-year-old toddler received heart.

State Comptroller report: Despite government efforts to bring foreign workers to construction during Iron Swords war after Palestinian worker closure, shortage of approximately 37,000 non-Israeli workers remained as of June 2025.
גבר בן 61 נפצע באורח קל מרסיסים בגפיים בטמרה בעקבות מטח שיגורי רקטות מלבנון
ראש העיר אופקים איציק דנינו: 'דווקא בעת הזו, עלינו להמשיך לבחור בחיים, להרים את הראש, להתכנס יחד כקהילה, ולחזק את הרוח שמחזיקה אותנו'
בשל המצב הביטחוני והנחיות פיקוד העורף, חוף הגן הלאומי אכזיב ייוותר סגור עד הודעה חדשה
חופי ים נפתחו לרחצה: חוף בית ינאי, שמורת הטבע חוף פלמחים והגן הלאומי תל אשקלון
נחיל של מאות דבורים חדר למרכז המסחרי בנתיבות והביא לסגירה זמנית של העסקים במקום
ראשי רשויות בצפון פרסמו הודעות לתושביהן כי ישנה התראה על מטחי ירי של חיזבאללה בטווח הזמן הקרוב
עמית סופר, ראש המועצה האזורית מרום הגליל: 'תושבי קו העימות רוצים ביטחון אמיתי ולא שקט תעשייתי... אנחנו מבקשים שממשלת ישראל תמשיך להכות בחיזבאללה עד לפירוקו מנשקו'
משרד הבריאות הודיע על תוצאות חריגות של חיידקים בבריכת המשושים המעידות על זיהום; הכניסה למים עלולה להיות מסוכנת
הקרן לידידות ותנועת המושבים הודיעו על תוכנית להסבת מקלטים ציבוריים ביישובי הגדר למרכזי שהייה ארוכה, מצוידים בציוד למגורים ומרכזי עשרה
משרד החינוך: מתוך 93 יישובים במחוז צפון, 57 כבר פועלים כסדרם; מופעלים מענים רציפים לצוותים ולהורים ביישובים שבהם המעונות עוד לא נפתחו
עיריית קריית שמונה הודיעה לתושבים: 'לא ניתן לקיים את פעילות מערכת החינוך'
הורים מהצפון פנו לשר החינוך בדרישה למתווה דיפרנציאלי: 'הילדים שלנו חיים במציאות בלתי אפשרית'
הנהגת ההורים, מועצת התלמידים וראשי רשויות דורשים לשנות את מתווה הבחינות בטענה שהמתווה הקיים מתעלם מהמצב הנפשי של התלמידים
שא-נור חוברה מחדש לרשת החשמל; עובדי חברת החשמל שהוריד את השאלטר בעת הגירוש הדליקו אותו מחדש
המועצה האזורית גוש עציון חציתה רף של 30,000 תושבים; בשנה האחרונה הצטרפו 931 תושבים חדשים בקצב גידול של כ-3.6%
יו"ר ש"ס אריה דרעי קיים פגישת עבודה עם ראש עיריית צפת לדון בצרכי העיר בתקופת המלחמה
בנק ישראל הודיע כי מתווה הסיוע ללקוחות הבנקים שנפגעו במבצע 'שאגת הארי' יוארך בחודש נוסף
מבקר המדינה: בתחילת מלחמת חרבות ברזל לא היה נוהל לתיעדוף חזרת ישראלים מחו"ל; חיילים ואנשי מילואים נאלצו לחפש טיסות עצמאית ולשלם מחירים גבוהים
משרד התרבות והספורט מודיע על הקדמת תכנית מופעי הקיץ לשנת 2026 וביצוע סל תרבות
Etihad Airways חזרה לפעילות סדירה בקו בין תל אביב לאבו דאבי
האירוע המסורתי של יום העצמאות בוטל בשל המצב הביטחוני והנחיות פיקוד העורף
דובר צה"ל בערבית אביחי אדרעי פרסם הוראת פינוי לתושבי דרום לבנון: 'פעילות הטרור של חיזבאללה מאלצת את צה"ל לפעול כנגדו במרחב'
מגישת ערוץ 14 נוי בר: 'ילדתי תחת טילים, ראיתי כוכבים מהכאב'
בעת הלידה התרחשה מתקפת טילים; הובלה לחדר לידה ממוגן בשל מתקפה שהתרחשה באותן דקות
מרים טאיירי, אם לשני ילדים עם מוגבלויות: 'כשהיא צועדת, אנשים מסביב פשוט עוצרים ומתרגשים. זה רגע שבו היא לא הילדה עם המוגבלות - היא חלק מהקהל'

Authorities and regional councils in the northern border area issued immediate warnings to residents to stay close to protected spaces due to concrete indications of imminent missile fire from Lebanon
Residents and shoppers in Netivot experienced panic when tens of thousands of bees invaded the commercial center; people screamed and fled to enclosed spaces
Business owners in the commercial center closed shop doors and windows in response to the bee swarm
IDF spokesman reports: one paratrooper severely wounded and four soldiers lightly wounded from rocket fire in southern Lebanon; evacuated to hospital
Thousands of Jews immigrated to Israel during a complex security period, described as 'a certificate of honor for national resilience'
Highway 1 westbound near Yaarim junction closed to traffic due to truck fire; heavy traffic congestion reported
Residents in Netivot experienced panic when tens of thousands of bees invaded the commercial center; people screamed and fled to enclosed spaces
Business owners closed shop doors and windows in response to bee swarm; municipality requested residents to avoid the area
Approximately 15 toddlers arrived at Dana-Dwek hospital with symptoms of food poisoning (vomiting and diarrhea); most in mild condition

Ministry of Education estimates: approximately 40% of northern students have not returned to physical classes and remain disconnected from the education system for over 1.5 months, relying on remote learning only

Of approximately 120,000 students (60%) who returned to educational institutions in the north, the vast majority study in small groups and capsules or only within protected spaces to comply with strict Home Front Command shelter-in-place times

Bank of Israel extended its relief framework adopted by banks in early March for an additional month, stating 'the campaign has not yet ended' and continuing support for households and small businesses
Nature and Parks Authority issued sharp warning to public planning to hike in Dead Sea, Negev, or Arava areas due to risk of flash floods on Friday; absolute prohibition on entering wadi channels

Police completed preparations for state cup semifinal match at Teddy Stadium in Jerusalem with 5,000 capacity limit per Home Front Command guidelines; deployed officers, security personnel, and traffic management
'Peamim' organization provided special holiday grants to 850 families; many are evacuees and reserve duty families affected by the war
Head of Matte Asher regional council Moshe Davidowitz warned residents to stay near protected spaces 'from now and for the coming hours' due to possible increased fire from Lebanon
IDF spokesman reports: five soldiers wounded from rocket fire in southern Lebanon, one severely and four lightly; evacuated to hospital and families notified

Research based on hundreds of thousands of employees (2023-2025): 9.4% of workers performed reserve duty with average of 188 days since October 7, showing significant burden concentrated on small subset of population
IDF spokesman reports: battalion commander (Mag-D 52) in armored corps severely wounded during operational activity in southern Lebanon; evacuated to hospital and family notified

Culture and Stage Productions Union coordinated with local government center to reschedule Independence Day performances cancelled due to emergency; budgets allocated for Independence Day will be transferred to alternative performances

Ministry of Construction and Housing delayed opening of 'Apartment at Discount' lottery registration to advance emergency order allocating half of apartments to reserve duty soldiers, adding 1,139 apartments to soldier allocation in upcoming lottery

State Comptroller report (October 2023 - March 2025) documents extensive failures: lack of preparedness for prolonged war, failure to control flight price increases, inadequate response to Israelis stranded abroad, failure to return foreign carriers to Israel

Following ceasefire announcement in Operation Shaagat Hari, foreign airlines gradually resuming operations to Israel with renewed routes and increased frequencies; however, fuel price increases and limited flight supply leading to price increases

Village of Sha-Nur in northern Samaria reconnected to national electricity grid; two electricity company workers who disconnected power 20 years ago performed the reconnection, symbolizing restoration of services

Ziv Medical Center in Safed gradually returning hospital departments and outpatient clinics to original above-ground locations after months of operating from underground fortified complexes; coordinated with security authorities and Health Ministry
Ziv Medical Center director Professor Salman Zarqa stated: 'We work with responsibility and caution, maintaining full readiness to return to fortification at any moment if necessary'
Magen David Adom reports: 61-year-old man lightly wounded from rocket fire in Tamra area from Lebanon

Police and Shin Bet announce: Shomua Abu Abed from Nazareth charged with spying for Iran, filming security sites including Haifa oil refinery and IDF bases, transmitting information about former security official in exchange for cryptocurrency since October

IDF spokesman Col. Avichay Adraee reiterates wide-scale evacuation warning for southern Lebanon: 'for your safety, we again urge you to evacuate your homes immediately and move at once to north of the Zahrani River'
Hezbollah fired dozens of rockets, sending tens of thousands of Israelis to bomb shelters
Hezbollah rocket barrage wounding one Israeli
Magen David Adom said the 61-year-old was hit by shrapnel near the city of Tamra
Civil air traffic largely curtailed following October 7 attack; many foreign carriers repeatedly suspended or canceled Tel Aviv routes
State Comptroller found no procedure in place to prioritize return of Israeli passengers abroad during war; soldiers and reservists struggled with air travel options and bore high financial burdens
Mateh Asher Regional Council and Nahariya Municipality tell residents to remain close to bomb shelters, citing military information about planned Hezbollah rocket fire
Smadar Elad, psychotherapist, attended dance workshop for women over 50 after October 7 to process trauma
Residents of northern Israel watched with skepticism at negotiations; reality in the north appears far from peace despite ongoing Hezbollah rocket fire and drones
Lt. Col. A., commander of 75th Battalion: 'They have fire in their eyes...their motivation is at its peak'
IDF cancels Independence Day flyover and naval parade for third straight year due to continued combat in Lebanon and broader security situation
Etihad Airways resumed operations to Israel with Boeing 787 landing at Ben Gurion Airport; initially operating two daily flights, expanding to four by May 2
Rabbi Shlomo Aviner entered Gaza combat zone to deliver classes and inspirational speeches to IDF troops; soldier reported: 'It wasn't just a visit; it strengthened the soul'
Armed civilian at Doron Valley Farm prevented stabbing attack by drawing personal firearm and shooting terrorist who attempted to stab Israeli civilians
Bereaved families warn against complacency on southern front, stating 'The central lesson of October 7 is that no threat can be taken lightly' and demanding decisive military action
13-year-old student in Be'er Ya'akov targeted by coordinated cyberbullying campaign with fake obituary notice and TikTok page designed to intensify social boycott
State Comptroller report: no system in place to prioritize return of Israelis stranded abroad; soldiers and reservists forced to arrange own flights at significant personal cost
State Comptroller audit: no government body conducted comprehensive assessment of long-term economic impact from shortage of foreign and Palestinian workers following October 7
